title: Open commitments by due time
description: Every open commitment (received to done, and breached), soonest due first; late or breached rows show the warn tone.
why: A commitment to an outside party is what the company can lose; the owner sees what is due, who owns it and what is already late without asking.

actions.label: Ask the CEO about this
actions.text: Commitment "{{row.title}}" ({{row.id}}) is {{row.state}}, due {{row.dueAt}}, owned by {{row.owner}}. Is it on track?
